title: gnaphalium obtusifolium var. saxicola
intro: Gnaphalium obtusifolium var. saxicola, commonly known as Rock cudweed, is a plant species belonging to the daisy family. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Rock cudweed include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe wounds, reduce pain, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Rock cudweed include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities.
